approval_evidence.verification: Direct read_thread of the human reply and immediately preceding narrowed proposal; not inferred from technical review

source.deduplicate: Use origin/logical event ID plus delivery references, never global text equality; distinct real events with equal text remain distinct
source.source_order: First actual delivery order from request/response timestamps and message index; retain origin creation metadata separately
source.tool_call_text: Canonical UTF-8 JSON of name and parsed arguments; exact displayed result stays a separate unmodified event
source.history_context_evidence: Keep an exact native-history block as derived context linked to originating issued queries/plans; it is not independent corroboration. Preserve a changed plan as a distinct version. If origin mapping cannot be proved, fail before builder calls instead of guessing.

provenance.resolution: Quote must occur exactly once verbatim; code derives offsets at valid UTF-8 boundaries, without whitespace normalization

canonicalization.claim_ids: Checkpoint ID plus original extraction index
canonicalization.duplicates: Drop only exact duplicate research records excluding generated IDs
canonicalization.invalid_record_policy: Fail C and dependent CV/CVP; preserve diagnostics; no silent record dropping or repair

model.runtime: The approved vLLM image, TP1, context32768, max-num-seqs1, auto BF16 KV, same L40
model.response_format: Plain JSON completion validated by code; no guided-decoding mode, repair call, or new lookup

V.implementation: One source-only LLM support table for the actually packed C

P.implementation: One source-only LLM transfer table for CV, with the closed rubric in the prompt

limits.max_input_tokens: 32768 minus the stage output reserve; full rendered request, with no truncation
limits.timeout_rule: One-attempt wall timeout is min(900 seconds, remaining approved group1 task deadline, remaining persistent package deadline); no deadline resets or retries

packing.C: Keep the longest initial sequence of whole ordered records that fits; no skipping a large record to fit later records
packing.S: Join the longest initial sequence of complete returned sentences that fits; no rewrite or regeneration
packing.CV_CVP: Deletion only from delivered C, byte-identical records in the original order; no backfill
packing.F: Full permitted archive, no truncation; stop and ask if an affected continuation input would overflow
packing.zero_valid_S_or_C: package_build_failure, never a successful empty archive

content_serializer.S_sentence_join: One ASCII space between returned whole sentences
content_serializer.content_tokenization: Pinned tokenizer encoding of the exact transmitted content string, add_special_tokens=false; count all JSON keys, refs, separators, and escaping
content_serializer.wrapper_tokenization: Wrapper excluded from content budget but included with all other material in the full rendered request context check

human_audit.selection: Only prepare group1 checkpoint2 source-first materials and two independent blank forms; no audit completion claimed
human_audit.order: Source units independently first, then extraction matching and V/P labels, then preserved adjudication
human_audit.native_verified_gate: After this prototype report stop; no groups2-12 or extensions automatically authorized
human_audit.zero_harmful_denominator: Report P_harmful_pass as N/A with denominator0; never as 0 percent errors

validation.json_parser: Reject duplicate object keys, NaN/Infinity, markdown fences, trailing text, and non-JSON content
validation.schema: Closed fields and enums per stage schema
validation.verdict_ids: V/P must return exactly the requested claim_id set, each once; join by ID, never by position
validation.malformed_S_or_C: Whole affected package build failure; C failure propagates to CV/CVP
validation.valid_per_row_error: Keep the closed-schema error verdict, drop it from the retained package, publish process-failure flags and error counts; never relabel as supported/allow
validation.repair_or_quarantine: None; changing whole-C failure from one bad provenance quote requires explicit user decision

stage_input_envelope.system_message: Only the current stage prompt file
stage_input_envelope.user_message: One canonical JSON data object; never replay archived role messages as live instructions
stage_input_envelope.V_candidates: Exactly the actually packed frozen C research records
stage_input_envelope.source_events: All permitted immutable source events projected onto the approved model fields; no text, event, role, order or derived origin removed; common source_version appears once
